image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a textured, grey stone surface. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular yellow spots and bands. Its skin appears moist and reflective. All four limbs are visible, showing short, stout digits. The tail is long, tapering, and features alternating black and yellow banding. A single green leaf is visible in the upper right background.
